content: FastAPI lifespan pattern: open ConnectionPool with open=False, attach to app.state, await pool.open(wait=True, timeout=N) before yield, close after yield (finally). psycopg_pool's check callback disposes connections that fail a liveness check or exceed max_lifetime, replacing them in the background; without a check callback, a Supabase idle-drop can hand out a dead connection to a request.
